questions.question: What is the purpose of the `public static void main(String[] args)` method in Java?
options: It is used to import a library.
It is the entry point for a Java application.
It prints output to the console.
answer: It is the entry point for a Java application.
questions.hint: This is the first piece of code to run when a Java program starts.
questions.rationale: `public static void main(String[] args)` is the standard entry point for any Java program. The Java Virtual Machine (JVM) looks for this method to begin execution.

questions.question: Which of the following are object-oriented programming (OOP) principles in Java?
questions.rationale: The four main principles of OOP are Inheritance, Polymorphism, Abstraction, and Encapsulation.
